facts.claim: The St. Regis Bali Resort hosts weddings: its own events page answers 'Does The St. Regis Bali Resort provide wedding services?' with 'Yes', and describes its 'Nusa Dua beach wedding venues, each inspired by Bali's natural beauty'.

The St. Regis Bali Resort describes the Cloud Nine Chapel as 'nestled on our exclusive beachfront' with Swarovski crystal chandeliers and ocean views, surrounded by a pond and cascading steps, with a wooden terrace beyond the pond for pre-dinner canapés and drinks.
The St. Regis Bali Resort capacity chart lists the Cloud Nine Chapel at 43.6 sq m, seating 30 theatre style and 18 banquet.
The St. Regis Bali Resort offers beachfront wedding ceremonies 'on our soft white sands', with floral styling such as Balinese frangipani or ivory roses.
The St. Regis Bali Resort's wedding text says the garden Amphitheatre suits 'larger gatherings of up to 80 guests in theatre-style seating', with soft background music 'available until 7 PM'.
The St. Regis Bali Resort capacity chart lists the Amphitheatre (338 sq m, outdoor) at 150 theatre style and 100 reception.
The St. Regis Bali Resort lists Cloud Nine Terrace (300 sq m, outdoor, Indian Ocean backdrop) at 250 reception and 250 banquet; its FAQ names it the largest-capacity event space.
The St. Regis Bali Resort lists the Astor Ballroom (290 sq m, garden views, adjoining wood terrace) at 150 banquet and 180 theatre style.
The St. Regis Bali Resort names The Dulang, in the resort's Tropical Park, as a wedding venue 'inspired by Bali's royal traditions' and lit with torches.
The St. Regis Bali Resort offers the Mezzanine of Kayuputi, a semi-private upper level of its fine-dining restaurant, for up to 20 guests, and promotes private venues for rehearsal dinners.
The St. Regis Bali Resort names a 'St. Regis Wedding Specialist' to manage florals, décor and guest accommodation, and offers a dedicated St. Regis butler on the wedding day.
The St. Regis Bali Resort says bespoke wedding cakes are made under its French maître pâtissier, and its signature hand bouquet is round white roses adorned with pearls.

insider_details.detail: At The St. Regis Bali Resort, the Cloud Nine Chapel seats only 30 (18 banquet), so a larger guest list either uses the beach or Amphitheatre for the ceremony, then moves to Cloud Nine Terrace (banquet 250) for dinner.

The St. Regis Bali Resort publishes a 7 PM limit for background music at the Amphitheatre, so plan garden ceremonies for late afternoon and move the party to another space for the evening; confirm music rules for the terrace at booking.
The St. Regis Bali Resort has an indoor fallback: the Astor Ballroom seats 150 banquet, useful as a rain plan for an outdoor terrace reception of up to 150.
For a welcome or rehearsal dinner for close family at The St. Regis Bali Resort, the Mezzanine of Kayuputi takes up to 20 guests.
